summary: Independently verified all requested features via API (curl) + UI (Playwright). Backend endpoints return expected values: detection-engineering mitre_coverage=92.9 with 13 tactic heatmap columns and finetuning.count=3 listing PowerShell/Recon Scan/C2 Beacon rules; soc-manager close_reason_mix has False Positive=4 and summary.false_positive_rate=40.0; qradar summary total_offenses=10, false_positives=6; log-sources total_enabled_log_sources=8 and log_sources_added=10; PPTX export returns HTTP 200 (~25MB). IRIS chat returns source=hf-llm, model=qwen2.5:1.5b with a real MITRE answer (correct payload key is 'message'). Upload modal exposes 'Log Sources (Inventory + Enabled)' option.
